aboutDescriptions: Travel opens the door to new experiences and unforgettable memories. Every month, we carefully handpick beautiful destinations that offer the perfect blend of adventure, culture, relaxation, and natural beauty.

Our travel experts explore, evaluate, and select places that promise exceptional experiences for every kind of traveler. Whether you're looking for peaceful beaches, exciting city escapes, or breathtaking landscapes, we have something special for you.

We go beyond just recommending places—we ensure that your journey is smooth, comfortable, and truly memorable. From the moment you plan your trip to the time you return home, we're with you every step of the way.

With our carefully chosen monthly destinations, you can discover new cultures, enjoy authentic experiences, and create memories that last a lifetime. Let us help you explore the world in the most beautiful way possible.

variant-1.subtitle: FAQS
variant-1.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, bookings and policies.

items.question: How long does a service take?
items.answer: The duration of a service depends on the type of service you selected. Generally, most services are completed within a few hours to a full day. You will get exact time details while booking your service.

items.question: How can I become a member?
items.answer: You can become a member by creating an account on our website. Fill in your details, verify your email, and start exploring exclusive member benefits and offers.

items.question: What payment methods do you support?
items.answer: We support credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, and approved digital wallets. All payments are processed through a secure checkout.

items.question: How can I cancel my request?
items.answer: You can cancel your booking from your account dashboard or by contacting our support team. Cancellation charges depend on how close the travel date is.

items.question: Is my personal information secure?
items.answer: Yes. We use secure encryption and never share your personal details with third parties except where required to complete your booking.

items.question: Do you provide support on weekends?
items.answer: Yes, our support team is available on weekends to help with bookings, changes, and travel queries.

items.question: How can I track my booking?
items.answer: After booking, you will receive a confirmation email with your booking ID. You can track status anytime from your account or by contacting support.

terms.title: Booking Policy
terms.text: A 30% advance payment is required to confirm the booking. Remaining amount is payable 15 days before departure.

terms.title: High Season
terms.text: Prices may vary during peak holidays, festivals, and long weekends. Final rates are confirmed at the time of booking.

terms.title: Payment
terms.text: We accept bank transfer, credit/debit cards, and approved digital wallets. Payment receipts will be shared instantly.

terms.title: Cancellation
terms.text: Cancellations made 20 days before travel are eligible for a partial refund. Later cancellations may be non-refundable.

terms.title: Visa & Conditions
terms.text: Travelers are responsible for valid passports and visas. TourVista can assist with documentation on request.

terms.title: Booking Time
terms.text: Packages should be booked at least 10 days in advance to secure hotels, transfers, and activity slots.

terms.title: Warranty
terms.text: Services are provided as described. Any service issue during the trip should be reported immediately for resolution.

terms.title: Refund Policy
terms.text: Approved refunds are processed within 7–10 working days to the original payment method.

1.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Maldives
1.nightsLine: 2N Male | 3N Overwater Villa | 1N Sandbank | 1N Reef Island
1.overviewText: The Maldives is a tropical island nation in the Indian Ocean, known for its crystal-clear lagoons, white-sand beaches, and overwater villas. This package is designed for a slow, luxurious island holiday with handpicked stays and daily experiences.
1.subtitle: Stay in overwater villas, snorkel crystal lagoons, and enjoy a slow, luxurious island holiday with your family.
overview: Private overwater villa with sunrise lagoon views
Daily breakfast and selected gourmet dinners
Guided snorkeling at vibrant coral reefs

delights.title: Sunset Cruise
delights.text: Sail across turquoise waters while the sky turns gold.

delights.title: Reef Snorkeling
delights.text: Swim with colorful fish in shallow, clear lagoons.

delights.title: Island Picnic
delights.text: A private sandbank lunch prepared by the resort chef.

delights.title: Spa Evening
delights.text: Couple or family spa session with ocean-view treatment rooms.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Male
points: Evening at leisure on the beach

itinerary.title: Lagoon & Leisure
points: Free time for swimming and spa

2.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Switzerland
2.overviewText: Switzerland is a land of alpine lakes, scenic trains, and charming villages. This journey takes you through Zurich, Lucerne, and Interlaken with a well-paced mix of sightseeing and mountain views.
2.subtitle: Ride mountain trains, wander lakeside towns, and experience the Swiss Alps with a well-paced group itinerary.
overview: Panoramic train journeys through the Alps
Lakeside stays in Interlaken and Lucerne
Cable car ride with mountain views

delights.title: Alpine Train
delights.text: Travel through valleys and snow-capped peaks in comfort.

delights.title: Lake Cruise
delights.text: A peaceful cruise on a crystal-clear Swiss lake.

delights.title: Mountain Peak
delights.text: Cable car ride to a viewpoint above the clouds.

delights.title: Local Tasting
delights.text: Sample authentic Swiss chocolate, cheese, and fondue.

itinerary.title: Interlaken Alps
points: Photo stops at lakes Brienz and Thun

3.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Cappadocia
3.nightsLine: 2N Goreme | 2N Cave Hotel | 2N Red Valley | 1N Avanos
3.overviewText: Cappadocia is a unique region of fairy chimneys, cave hotels, and sunrise balloon rides. This package combines valley walks, underground cities, and authentic local experiences.
3.subtitle: Float over fairy chimneys, explore cave hotels, and discover ancient valleys unique to Turkey.
overview: Guided valley hikes and photo walks

delights.title: Balloon Sunrise
delights.text: Float above the valleys as the sun lights the chimneys.

delights.title: Cave Stay
delights.text: Sleep in a beautifully restored Cappadocian cave suite.

delights.title: Valley Walk
delights.text: Easy trails through Love Valley and Goreme viewpoints.

delights.title: Pottery Art
delights.text: Try your hand at Avanos ceramic making with a local artist.

4.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Greece
4.overviewText: Greece is famous for whitewashed villages, caldera views, and island sunsets. This itinerary focuses on Santorini with walking tours, a catamaran cruise, and relaxed evenings by the sea.
4.subtitle: Combine Santorini sunsets, whitewashed villages, and a smooth corporate-friendly island itinerary.
overview: Guided Oia and Fira walking tour
Wine tasting at a cliffside vineyard

delights.title: Oia Sunset
delights.text: Watch the world-famous Santorini sunset from the cliffs.

delights.title: Caldera Cruise
delights.text: Sail the volcanic caldera with swimming and BBQ.

delights.title: Wine Tasting
delights.text: Sample Assyrtiko wines with a sea-view terrace.

delights.title: Village Walks
delights.text: Explore blue-dome churches and boutique lanes.

5.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Dubai
5.overviewText: Dubai is a city of modern landmarks, desert adventures, and luxury shopping. This demo package covers Downtown views, a desert safari, and Marina evenings in a compact 5-day plan.
5.subtitle: See Burj Khalifa, cruise Dubai Marina, and enjoy a desert safari in one easy city break.
overview: Guided city tour with photo stops

delights.title: Burj Views
delights.text: Visit the observation deck for skyline and fountain views.

delights.title: Desert Safari
delights.text: Dune bashing, camel photos, and a desert camp dinner.

delights.title: Marina Night
delights.text: Stroll the waterfront and optional dhow cruise.

delights.title: Mall Time
delights.text: Shopping and the Dubai Fountain show.

6.headline: The Most Beautiful Destination , Dubai
6.overviewText: This family-focused Dubai demo package mixes theme parks, the aquarium, and beach time so kids and adults both enjoy the trip.
6.subtitle: Theme parks, aquarium, and beach days designed for a relaxed family holiday in Dubai.

delights.title: Theme Park
delights.text: A full day of rides and shows for the kids.

delights.title: Aquarium
delights.text: Walk through tunnels with sharks and rays.

delights.title: Beach Time
delights.text: Easy JBR beach afternoon with ice cream stops.

delights.title: Desert Evening
delights.text: Family-friendly safari camp with dinner.

itinerary.title: Theme Park Day
points: Rides and lunch inside the park

variant-1.description: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

items.title: 1. Information We Collect
items.text: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you use our website, services, or contact us. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to provide.

items.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
items.text: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process your bookings, communicate with you, and personalize your travel experience.

items.title: 3. Information Sharing
items.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to others. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and delivering our services, under strict confidentiality agreements.

items.title: 4. Data Security
items.text: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

items.title: 5. Your Rights
items.text: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You can also opt out of receiving promotional communications from us at any time.

items.title: 6. Cookies
items.text: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings.

items.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
items.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated effective date.

variant-1.noteText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

variant-1.description: Please read these Terms & Conditions carefully before booking any tour or using our services.

items.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
items.text: By accessing our website or booking a package, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions and all applicable laws. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

items.title: 2. Booking & Confirmation
items.text: A booking is confirmed only after we receive the required payment and send a written confirmation. Traveller details must match official identification documents.

items.title: 3. Traveller Responsibilities
items.text: You are responsible for valid passports, visas, travel insurance, and following local laws. TourVista is not liable for delays or denial of entry due to incomplete documents.

items.title: 4. Package Changes
items.text: Itineraries may change due to weather, strikes, or operational reasons. We will offer suitable alternatives wherever possible without reducing the overall value of the trip.

items.title: 5. Conduct During Travel
items.text: Guests must behave respectfully toward guides, partners, and other travellers. We may refuse service to anyone whose conduct is unsafe or disruptive.

items.title: 6. Liability Limits
items.text: We act as an organizer and are not liable for acts of third-party hotels, airlines, or transport providers, except as required by law.

items.title: 7. Updates to Terms
items.text: These Terms & Conditions may be updated at any time. Continued use of our website or services after changes means you accept the revised terms.

variant-1.noteText: If you have any questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

variant-1.description: This Refund Policy explains when cancellations are allowed and how refunds are processed for TourVista bookings.

items.title: 1. Cancellation Requests
items.text: All cancellation requests must be sent in writing by email. The date we receive your request is used to calculate any refund.

items.title: 2. Refund Timeline
items.text: Cancellations made 30 days or more before departure may receive a higher refund. Closer to travel dates, refund amounts reduce as per the booking terms.

items.title: 3. Non-Refundable Items
items.text: Visa fees, airline tickets, insurance, and third-party deposits are often non-refundable once issued. These charges will be deducted from any refund.

items.title: 4. No-Show Policy
items.text: If you do not join the tour on the scheduled date without prior written notice, the booking is treated as a no-show and no refund is issued.

items.title: 5. Force Majeure
items.text: In events beyond our control such as natural disasters or government restrictions, we may offer a credit, reschedule, or partial refund as available.

items.title: 6. Refund Processing
items.text: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 10 to 15 working days after confirmation from our accounts team.

items.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
items.text: We may update this Refund Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page.

variant-1.noteText: If you have any questions about this Refund Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

variant-1.description: This Payment Policy outlines how deposits, balances, and accepted payment methods work for your bookings.

items.title: 1. Booking Deposit
items.text: A booking deposit is required to reserve your package. The remaining balance must be paid by the date mentioned in your confirmation.

items.title: 2. Accepted Methods
items.text: We accept bank transfers, debit/credit cards, and other approved online payment options. Cash payments are not accepted for international packages.

items.title: 3. Balance Due Date
items.text: Full payment is typically due 21 days before departure. Late payment may result in cancellation of services held with hotels or airlines.

items.title: 4. Secure Transactions
items.text: All online payments are processed through secure gateways. TourVista does not store your full card details on our servers.

items.title: 5. Pricing & Taxes
items.text: Quoted prices include the services listed in your itinerary. Airport taxes, visa fees, or personal expenses may be extra unless clearly mentioned.

items.title: 6. Failed or Pending Payments
items.text: If a payment fails or remains pending, the booking is not confirmed. Please share the transaction proof so we can verify and update your status.

items.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
items.text: We may update this Payment Policy from time to time. Please review this page before making a payment.

variant-1.noteText: If you have any questions about this Payment Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page.
